description.value:
From Ticket to Ride · Price: a Saint's Corpse part or blessed item must be carried, and the luck arrives in strange ways: while you carry it, you and your stand gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, AC and saving throws as blows and spells go strangely astray (or strangely true).

Theme Fate

  • 1: Reaction: once per round, a critical hit against you or your stand becomes a normal hit. Also, 1 action: jinx a creature within 30 ft, turning your luck against it (misfortune, @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save): on a success it takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls, AC and saving throws until the end of its next turn; on a failure or critical failure for 1 minute.
  • 5: Reaction, surge (once per round): your failed check becomes a success.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: An ally within 30 ft.
  • 17: Turn a critical failure into a critical success once per day. Strange luck grows: +2 status bonus.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
